reviews.text: Unfortunately, I had to move out of Milan, and my cats can no longer be cared for by the team at this wonderful clinic. I recommend it if you're looking for a place with highly trained and meticulous doctors who not only treat pets but also educate owners and offer preventive care. In addition to their expertise, I'd also like to highlight their prompt responses and helpfulness. I'd like to conclude with a special thank you to Dr. Iavazzo.

You are our safe haven for our Salina!
All the doctors at the clinic have been wonderful in every circumstance.
Their empathy, professionalism, and dedication are rare these days.
Thanks to Michela and all the staff!

They've been my safe haven for several years. All the doctors are thorough and very friendly.
A guarantee 🙂 …
A great team of doctors, attentive and competent
I found the staff very efficient and cutting-edge!
I brought my golden retriever with an ear hematoma, and thanks to the PRP treatment, he's now doing great and healed! Thanks to all the doctors! 🐾 …

The treated ear is curled up, balled up at the bottom and is much shorter than the other one, I love it more than before honestly but I thought it would turn out ALMOST like the other one, have a good day
We went with our boxer to have her ear hematoma treated... well, she's healed thanks to your excellent care! Special thanks to the entire team from Raia Angelo and Alessia from Cremona.

I've known Dr. Galgano and her team for 8 years, ever since I got Lola (a French bulldog). Unfortunately, my dog ​​has had several health problems over the years, some of which were very serious and difficult to diagnose.
I've always felt safe with Dr. Galgano; she's a serious, knowledgeable, and empathetic professional. Lola has always healed me successfully, despite the
complexity of the various situations.
I will always be grateful to her ♥️

This clinic diagnosed my cat with cancer. We tried all the treatments and the pain. I moved to another part of the city and found a new vet. I had them do a new assignment, and it turned out it WAS NOT CANCER AT ALL. Gallbladder disease. I'm currently looking for a lawyer to deal with them. Don't bring your pet here. They don't seem to know what they're doing. Shameful negligence.

They were available and prompt in carrying out all the clinical tests on my dog, even though I was unknown to them, after a whole afternoon of phone calls to other clinics where they denied me access due to lack of space or suitable equipment, here they received me immediately.

Here's Aku, 15 days after surgery, lively and affectionate.
Thank you... ❤️ to all of you for your attention, generosity, and expertise.
